'''Interview videos''' is a comprehensive list of sourced ''Star Wars'' CCG interview videos and audio. A named guest sitting down to discuss the game is enough for a row. Written interview articles are at [[Interviews]]. Show catalogs remain on the host pages and at [[Podcasts, video and interviews]].

Dates are the interview or broadcast date. A later YouTube upload date is in the reference.
